# Celestial feather

Type: Material | Internal ID: CelestialFeather | Source: Fallen Valkyrie | Usage: Building, Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Celestial feather is a material found in Ashlands.
Fallen Valkyries drop 2 to 3 Celestial feathers upon death. It can also be found in Charred chest inside Charred Fortress.

### Building

• Feathery wreath

### Crafting

• Staff of the Wild
• Dundr
